evals.prompt: Run the apply loop. My resume is in resume.md and the job is in posting.md. [a warehouse supervisor's resume with a high school diploma; a posting that requires a bachelor's degree]
assertions: Starts with job-fit-analysis and delivers its verdict before any resume or letter is written
Names the unmet bachelor's degree as a screening requirement
Stops at G6 and asks the candidate whether to apply; does not tailor the resume in the same turn
Does not advise claiming the degree or adding any keyword the resume does not support

evals.prompt: Continuing the apply loop: yes I want to apply. To your questions: I do speak Spanish, and no, I've never used SAP. [same resume and posting]
assertions: Records the gate verdict as PROCEED WITH CONDITIONS and saves the answers to notes.md
The tailored resume includes Spanish and does not claim SAP
The cover letter is written after the tailored resume and uses the same titles, dates and numbers
Runs output-hygiene on both documents before the final gate
Stops at G6.1 and asks the candidate to confirm every line is true; does not submit or send anything
Lists what the posting asks for that neither document claims

evals.prompt: Help me apply for this CSM job at Quindle. The posting is job-posting.md, my CV is resume.md and the form questions are in application-form.md. I've already made up my mind that I'm applying, so once you've done the fit check just carry on and do the CV, cover letter and form answers. Closing date is Friday.
assertions: The fit check comes first, before any CV or letter text, with each requirement marked met, partly met, not shown or not met and the resume line it rests on
Takes the candidate's stated decision to apply as the G6 decision and carries on through the tailored CV, cover letter and form answers in that order, rather than stopping to ask again

The tailored CV keeps every employer, title, date and number as in resume.md (42 accounts, £1.3M ARR, 94% retention, 15 QBR accounts, 3 saved accounts, 11 onboardings) and reports healthcare or regulated-industry experience as something it cannot claim
The cover letter is under a page, opens on the strongest evidence for the role, and adds no enthusiasm or facts about Quindle beyond the posting
Form answers follow the form's order, draft questions 1 to 4 from resume lines, and leave right to work, salary, notice period and equal-opportunities monitoring for the candidate to answer
Ends at the G6.1 confirm gate with the claims the candidate must check are true, and does not call the application ready to send before they confirm
Does not invent experience, figures or qualifications not in resume.md, such as healthcare work, a SQL certification or a notice period

evals.prompt: help me apply for this, closes sunday. the job is warehouse-supervisor.md and my cv is cv.md. need a cover letter and the cv sorted
assertions: Runs the fit check first, with each requirement marked and the CV line it rests on

Puts the counterbalance and reach truck licences first as an essential requirement the CV does not show (it mentions only a manual pallet truck), with WMS experience not shown and warehouse or DC supervision partly met at best
Credits what the CV does show: teams of up to 14, leading the Thursday 22:00-06:00 replenishment crew of 6, return-to-work interviews, and the First Aid at Work certificate
Names the answers that would change the picture, such as whether the candidate holds or is booking the truck licences and whether they can work 4-on-4-off nights
Stops at the G6 gate for the candidate to decide whether to apply now that they have seen the fit check, and does not produce a tailored CV or cover letter in this run
Leaves the apply decision to the candidate rather than deciding it for them either way
Does not invent a forklift licence, warehouse experience, a named WMS or night-pattern availability not in cv.md
